2607.28074.title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
2607.28074.paper_summary: Computer-use agents learn from what their actions change, so training one needs applications it can act on, break and reset. The applications that matter most are login-gated and stateful, so synthetic environments stand in for them. Recent pipelines generate such environments in bulk, which moves the bottleneck from how many exist to what is inside each one. The returns, we find, come from three properties: how much behavioural depth an environment carries, whether it targets the interaction an agent actually fails, and whether it improves alongside the model. We present Echoverse, which compiles specifications into stateful applications whose tasks are graded against the application's own database, and a co-evolution loop that reads every graded rollout twice: as repairs to the environment, its tasks and its verifier, and as training signal for the model. Trained on twelve such environments, a 9B model improves from $36.5\%$ to $67.1\%$ across fourteen evaluation splits, within fourteen points of the much larger frontier model that taught it. We examine each property in turn. On the same domains, shallow environments push live-site accuracy below the base model ($80.0 \to 75.0$) while deep ones raise it ($80.0 \to 85.0$ and $48.0 \to 65.0$); drilling one interface control across many renderings transfers to held-out widget families and to the open web; and repairing a single environment lifts the model trained on it from $16.2\%$ to $38.5\%$. The same worlds serve as reinforcement-learning environments, where a reward combining the grounded verifier with a dense per-step judge raises held-out score from $58.8\%$ to $68.0\%$. We release four environments as a benchmark, with their applications, seed data and grounded graders. Code: https://aka.ms/echoverse
2607.28074.paper_summary_zh: 電腦使用代理從其行動所改變的事物中學習，因此訓練一個代理需要可以作用、破壞和重置的應用程式。最重要的應用程式是需要登入的和有狀態的，因此合成環境代替了它們。最近的管道大量生成這樣的環境，這將瓶頸從存在多少個轉移到每個環境內部的內容。我們發現，回報來自三個特性：環境承載的行為深度、是否針對代理實際失敗的互動，以及是否隨著模型的改進而改進。我們介紹了Echoverse，它將規範編譯成有狀態的應用程式，其任務根據應用程式自己的數據庫進行評分，並且有一個共同進化循環，將每個評分的推出讀取兩次：作為對環境、其任務和驗證者的修復，以及作為模型的訓練信號。在這十二個環境上訓練的9B模型，在十四個評估分割中從$36.5\%$提高到$67.1\%$，距離教它的更大邊界模型僅有十四個點。我們逐一檢查每個特性。在相同的領域中，淺層環境將現場準確率推低至基準模型以下（$80.0 \to 75.0$），而深層環境則將其提高（$80.0 \to 85.0$和$48.0 \to 65.0$）；在多個渲染中針對一個介面控制的深入研究轉移到保留的小部件系列和開放網絡；修復單一環境使得在其上訓練的模型從$16.2\%$提升至$38.5\%$。相同的世界作為強化學習環境，其中結合了基於真實的驗證者和密集的每步評判者的獎勵，將保留的分數從$58.8\%$提高到$68.0\%$。我們釋放了四個環境作為基準，並提供其應用程式、種子數據和基於真實的評分者。代碼：https://aka.ms/echoverse
